installer.name: Workstation Setup
installer.description: Configure this workstation with tools and settings for managing KVM environments

preChecks.name: Virt-manager Available
preChecks.errorMessage: virt-manager is not installed (will be installed)

configFields.label: KVM Host Address
configFields.description: IP address or hostname of the KVM host to manage

configFields.label: KVM Host Username
configFields.description: SSH user on the KVM host

configFields.label: Install Virt-Manager
configFields.description: Install virt-manager GUI for managing virtual machines

configFields.label: Install Cockpit Client Tools
configFields.description: Install cockpit-client for browser-based VM management

configFields.label: Configure SSH Key Authentication
configFields.description: Generate and deploy an SSH key to the KVM host for passwordless access

commands.cmd: sudo dnf install -y virt-manager virt-viewer libvirt-client 2>&1
commands.description: Installing virt-manager and libvirt client tools

installSteps.name: SSH Key Setup
installSteps.description: Configuring SSH key authentication to KVM host

commands.cmd: test -f ~/.ssh/id_ed25519 && echo 'SSH key already exists' || ssh-keygen -t ed25519 -f ~/.ssh/id_ed25519 -N '' -q
echo 'Run: ssh-copy-id {{kvmUser}}@{{kvmHost}} to deploy your key'
echo 'Testing connection to {{kvmHost}}...' && ping -c 1 -W 3 {{kvmHost}} 2>&1 && echo 'Host reachable' || echo 'WARNING: Host unreachable (may be offline)'
commands.description: Testing network connectivity to KVM host

commands.cmd: echo '=== Workstation Summary ===' && echo 'KVM Host: {{kvmHost}}' && echo 'User: {{kvmUser}}' && echo '' && echo '=== Installed Tools ===' && (which virt-manager 2>/dev/null && echo 'virt-manager: installed' || echo 'virt-manager: not installed') && (which virsh 2>/dev/null && echo 'virsh: installed' || echo 'virsh: not installed')
